body.message:
Well noted your arrival timing. In this case, we will arrange a self check-in for you, as we are a holiday home operator and our working hours are from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

On the day of your arrival, our team will share all the apartment details, including the unit number, parking details, Wi-Fi information, and other necessary instructions. Once you arrive, you may simply proceed to the reception to complete the check-in process.

Thank you.
